messages:
Asha Patel: Folks — quick sync on Optimize toolkit + evals for Q2 planning. Need to agree scope and launch criteria by EOD Friday. Main customer asks: automatic batching/caching recommendations, regressions alerts tied to prompt sets, and a lightweight rollout dashboard.
Tom Reynolds: +1. Can we clarify what 'automatic recommendations' means? simple heuristics (batch size by latency curve) or full autoscaler integration?
Asha Patel: Start with heuristics and safety gates. We can call it 'recommendation mode v0' — suggests batch sizes, cache TTLs, and quantization candidates with expected token-cost delta. No autoscaling for v0.
Jen Park: Engineering constraints — kvcache prefix invalidation and continuous-batching infra need ~4w to harden and test. If we push heuristics now we can ship UI + rules by Q2 cut, but gating (auto-apply) must wait.
Samir Gupta: Evals side: we need baseline prompt sets per customer segment + regression threshold. Proposal: for launch, support 3 prompt suites (chat, completion, retrieval) and a default regression gate of 2% drop in ROUGE/accuracy depending on metric. Any objections?
Clara Nguyen: Sounds reasonable. Customer-facing launch criteria should be: (1) heuristics recommendations available in console, (2) eval gate raising flagged regressions with explainers, (3) perf targets documented (p95 inference change <5ms when enabling recommendations).
Luis Alvarez: Note on Dedicated/Private customers — recommendations must include an explicit 'do not apply' mode and exportable config. Also KMS/HSM notes for prompt telemetry.
Tom Reynolds: Engineering ask: if we keep auto-apply off, we can decouple rollout. I'd push for telemetry + feature-flagged apply in Dedicated later. Timeline: kvcache + batching infra (4w), UI + rules engine (2w), eval integration + gating (3w). Total 9w, but parallelize some tasks.
Jen Park: I'll own infra plan and put up a risk list. Biggest dev risk is continuous-batching regressions under long-chat workloads — need load tests.
Samir Gupta: On evals infra: I'll write the harness for prompt-suite regression runs and integrate with the alerting pipeline. Need sample sets from Solutions Eng by Tue.
Asha Patel: Decision draft: MVP scope = recommendation-mode (read-only suggestions), eval regression gating for 3 prompt suites, console UI with explainers, exportable configs for Dedicated. Defer auto-apply, visualizer, and model quantization suggestions to v1. OKRs to link: reduce per-token cost by 7% for targeted workloads, and detect 95% of regressions >2% on our sample sets.
Clara Nguyen: Can we add launch checklist items: docs + SDK examples, 3 customer beta slots, and an SLO for recommendation correctness (manual review pass rate >90%)?
Tom Reynolds: Added: e2e test matrix and perf benchmark (p95 latency delta <150ms baseline). I'll attach perf harness later.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for branch "kvcache/batching-stabilize" on staging at 2025-06-04T18:00Z.
Luis Alvarez: Heads-up for sales: we'll prepare messaging that this is "recommendation mode" not auto-tune. Important for enterprise compliance.
Asha Patel: Action items: Jen to post infra timeline + risks by Wed; Samir to drop prompt suites by Tue; Tom to share perf harness by Thu; Clara to scope docs & beta plan. We'll re-run prioritization in Thurs AM 11:00.
Jen Park: Understood, I'll post a short RFC in #eng-ml with the timeline.
Samir Gupta: I'll ping SEs for sample prompts and start the harness this afternoon.
Clara Nguyen: I'll draft beta invite language and minimal docs outline.
Asha Patel: Great — thanks all. If nobody objects by EOD Friday we'll lock the MVP scope. :thumbsup:
